seoTitle: Meta Tag Generator for HTML and Social Sharing
metaDescription: Generate HTML metadata, canonical tags, Open Graph tags and X card markup.
intro: Generate HTML metadata, canonical tags, Open Graph tags and X card markup.
aboutTitle: What metadata does the generator produce?
about: The generator turns the fields you enter into HTML tags for a page head. Use the title and description for the page itself and Open Graph or X fields for sharing previews.
exampleTitle: Prepare tags for a new service page
example: Enter a title that names the service, a description that explains what visitors can do, and the preferred page URL. Copy the markup into the page head and inspect the published URL.

faqs.question: Does generating tags change my site?
faqs.answer: Copy the generated markup into your CMS or page template, then publish the page to apply it.
